en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal harbor lined with wooden houses and boathouses on rocky shores. Several sailboats and small fishing boats are moored along both sides of the narrow inlet, while a small rowboat with two people is in the foreground on calm water. In the background, a church with a tower rises above the village. The word "GRUNDSUND." is printed in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 2102 appears in the lower right.
